run_caesar_cipher: run the Caesar cipher function f_gold to shift all characters in a text string by a given number
test_caesar_cipher: test the Caesar cipher implementation by comparing f_filled output against the f_gold reference function
encode_text_with_shift: encode a text string using the Caesar cipher by shifting each character by a specified integer offset
review_caesar_cipher: review the f_gold Caesar cipher function that shifts uppercase and lowercase letters independently
summarize_caesar_cipher: summarize the Caesar cipher implementation that rotates alphabetic characters by a given shift value
